$comment: Portal launcher catalog — default services of the DGX Spark host. Live copy: ~/.cowork/portal.json (override with COWORK_PORTAL), seeded from this file on first run and hot-reloaded on save. Per service: url (required; http(s)://… or a /path on the dashboard), label, description, icon (lucide name), category, enabled, order, accent (#hex), probe (health-check URL, or false), unit + controllable (systemd --user lifecycle buttons; also needs serviceControl.enabled in config.json). localhost URLs are rewritten to the dashboard's host for remote viewers.
